rv.q: Still, it zips along cheerily enough, and compared with We Will Rock You, it's a work of untrammelled genius.

cn.t: Critics pan this Spice Girls jukebox musical, with reviewers finding it insultingly shoddy and comparing it unfavorably to the already-maligned "We Will Rock You."
